I replied to Ilse in her #north-team thread. I said I'd keep her tip as unverified and won't treat Oriel Brevik as the contact of record yet.

I searched the knowledge brain and only used what Ilse can see herself. Nothing there confirms Oriel Brevik as the main contact for Marrow Fieldworks, and I found no mention of a Linden rollout at all. The search ran in keyword-only mode, so a note worded differently could have been missed. A public note says Marrow Fieldworks is a Central team account, so I suggested Ilse ask the Central team to confirm.

No other action was needed: there was no finance information, no outside email and nothing that needed approval.
